newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Kimbyr stands in market for Underground.
newsitem.headline: Kimbyr stands in market for Underground.

text.p: Underground Fashions said on Monday it had been advised that major shareholders, the Barry and Diane Rissetto family interests, have been in discussions with Kimbyr Investments Limited (a company wholly owned by Just Jeans Holdings Limited) as to the sale of their shares in the Company to Kimbyr.

As part of these discussions, the Rissettos have requested Kimbyr to stand in the market in respect of all other shareholders for at least one week, and at the same price (33.5 cents/share) as has been offered to the Rissettos.
The shares last traded at 28 cents.

The company said it understood that a Restricted Transfer notice would be issued by Kimbyr in respect of the offer to the Rissetos and the on market offer to the other shareholders, and that the independent director, Stuart Cairns, will consider the terms of the offer immediately on receipt and thereafter will make a further announcement to the exchange.
